description:
route_method rejects requests where the caller's accountId does not match their canonical account. This is an authorization boundary. The rejection is currently silent (returns accountNotFound with no log). Add an audit event.

## Current code (route_method, server.rs ~line 583)
  if let Some(requested_id) = args.get("accountId").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
      if requested_id != canonical_account_id {
          let err = MethodError::account_not_found();
          return serde_json::to_value(&err).unwrap_or(json!({}));
      }
  }

## Audit event to add
  tracing::warn!(
      audit              = true,
      event.type         = "authz.cross_account",
      method             = %method,
      username           = %username,
      requested_account  = %requested_id,
      own_account        = %canonical_account_id,
      "cross-account access attempt",
  );

## Note on frequency
This will fire on misconfigured clients as well as actual attacks.
The warn! level is appropriate — it surfaces in monitoring without
being as loud as error!, and the audit = true field routes it to the
audit log group regardless of level.

## Acceptance
- Test: authenticated user requesting a different accountId → authz.cross_account event emitted
- Test: authenticated user requesting their own accountId → no authz.cross_account event
- requested_account and own_account fields are both present in the event
title: Add audit event for JMAP cross-account accountId rejection
